explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma saying that the pairwise products of two commuting complete orthogonal families of idempotents form a complete orthogonal family indexed by I × J. I listed every `CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.*` and `OrthogonalIdempotents.*` lemma in Mathlib/RingTheory/Idempotents.lean: iff_ortho_complete, pair_iff, single, map, equiv, option, prod_one_sub, lift_of_isNilpotent_ker, bijective_pi and others. None of them concerns products of two families. I also grepped all of Mathlib for `CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents` (it appears in only 4 files: Smooth/Pi, Etale/QuasiFinite and DirectSum/Idempotents besides that one) and for `OrthogonalIdempotents (fun`. Neither search turned up such a result. The library's proof relies on `iff_ortho_complete`, `Fintype.sum_prod_type` and `Fintype.sum_mul_sum`, so it is a genuine argument rather than an application of a single Mathlib lemma.
